messages:
sam: FYI we got a spike of fncall validation failures on route=nl-summarize in ap-south around 03:40 UTC. Users saw errors; SLO noise.
nina: is this the new strict schema we rolled yesterday?
sam: yes. The model returned an array for `highlights` instead of object, so validator flagged as wrong_type. Example we pulled:
```json
{
  "summary": "...",
  "highlights": ["point1", "point2"]
}
```
devon: our schema expects `highlights: { bullets: string[] }` — mismatch. In previous permissive mode we coerced and accepted.
irene: how many rejects and are they billable? ops-bot?
ops-bot: fncall.validate.reject count=128 route=nl-summarize region=ap-south severity=hard code=wrong_type validation_build=2026-03-20 sample_rate=0.005 billable=false
sam: sample_rate is tiny so console has no examples. We need a way for engineers to fetch a redacted sample on demand.
nina: agreed. Proposal: add a "Fetch sample" button in the console for a given reject signature that pulls one recent raw payload (redacted) from warm logs, with tenant consent and audit log. That avoids increasing default sampling.
devon: +1. Also suggest a compact signature field on rejects: e.g., sig=sha1(sorted_keys + error_code) so we can group similar failures without payload.
irene: watch out for metric cardinality. If we add signature as a label to Prom metrics, that'll explode. Keep signature in event store only; expose only a small set of top signatures in the dashboard aggregated by route.
sam: ops: can we temporarily flip route back to permissive while we ship UI?
ops-bot: change_request received. Pending approval by release leads.
ops-bot: Note: emergency permissive toggle executed for route=nl-summarize at 1768465042 by ops. Validation reverted to permissive.
nina: for telemetry: propose metrics split: fncall.validate.rejects.total, fncall.validate.rejects.hard, fncall.validate.rejects.soft. Keep billing label (billable=true/false) and include validation_build only in sampled event payloads.
devon: implementation note: store signature as a 64-bit truncated hash to reduce cardinality; use that as a UI grouping key but never attach freeform keys to Prom metrics.
irene: console UX: show for each signature: count, first_seen, last_seen, sample_link (when available), and top 3 differing fields (inferred diff). Allow "request sample" (consent) and "bookmark" for safety teams.
sam: rollout plan: revert for now, ship sample button + redaction flow + signature generator, then re-canary strict validator at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 12h observation windows. If hard rejects > 1/min baseline or customer error rate rises > 50% alert and rollback.
ops-bot: alerting rule proposed: fire when fncall.validate.rejects.hard[5m] > 5x baseline for route AND error_budget_drop > 20%.
nina: also add a meter for rejected-but-coerced events so product teams can see functional impact even when permissive accepts. Metric name idea: fncall.validate.coerce.count.
devon: I'll sketch the signature algo and a retention policy: keep signatures in TSDB for 30d, raw sampled payloads for 7d, and on-demand exports to S3 with tenant consent.
irene: privacy checklist: tenant opt-out, automatic PII redaction (emails, phone numbers, credit card), audit log every sample disclosure.
sam: final actions: Devon -> PR for signature generator + storage; Nina -> telemetry PR & alert rules; Ops -> confirm rollback is stable and post rollout timeline; Irene -> redact & privacy checklist. I'll notify support with a brief summary.
ops-bot: rollback confirmed complete at 1768465043. Suppressing related alerts for 30m.
sam: thanks everyone, keep updates in this thread and link PRs.
